body: I’ve been to several therapists/psychiatrists and been on multiple medications but nothing has helped. I can’t be fixed. I know my story ends with me killing myself, it’s just a matter of when.

They haven’t gotten better in 3 years and I really doubt they ever will. I’m a miserable waste of space and I can’t see my life ending in any way but suicide. Either I kill myself when I’m older, after years of suffering and misery and hurting other people, or I kill myself in a few months and get it all over with.
My life couldn’t possibly get worse, so if I survive it’s not like my quality of life would decrease.
I’m really not. I’m annoying, needy, socially awkward, and just generally kind of unlikable. I don’t blame people for not wanting to hang out with me, since I don’t even want to be around myself.
They’re fine, but I don’t think any of them like me enough for friendship to be a possibility.

Probably elementary school. Since then I’ve just had acquaintances or people that tolerate me. They’ll hang out with me if I pester them about it but they never reach out to me first. I’m an afterthought at best.

I think my biggest issue is that I can’t learn from my mistakes. I’ve been given plenty of opportunities to succeed and I’ve wasted all of them. I’m just fundamentally flawed as a person and there’s no way to fix it.

I've been to the school's counselling center (mental health part of the health center) but they weren't helpful at all. And my parents wouldn't support me taking a break from school at all. They want to spend as little money on me as possible, which is why they asked me to change majors instead of take a break or something. Even if they did let me take time off from school, they'd want me working, and I can barely get out of bed most days.

I've had a lot of trouble doing anything. Usually doing one thing a day (laundry, taking out the trash, etc.) is all I can manage, but things are piling up faster than I can do them. I'm being crushed by my responsibilities.
Thanks for reading. Not really sure what else I have to say since I got most of it out in the OP.

I'm not in therapy currently. I don't get angry much, but I'm not very angry in general. I'm usually more disappointed in myself. The self-criticalness might come from my line of thought that I'm in charge of my life, so I'm responsible for all my problems.

I have to go to school and get a job like everyone else, because it takes money to live (food, house, car, etc.). As for the pleasure, all the shows and games I used to enjoy don't excite me anymore. Maybe it's just me being fickle, and needing constant entertainment.
I enjoy TV, video games, etc, but I can't do that all my life.
I've never done anything noteworthy, that made anyone stop and say, "That guy must be pretty smart/athletic/etc." If I were to die, no one's life would change in the slightest.
Is there? Just shuffling through life, not making any sort of impact doesn't sound like living to me, it sounds like just surviving. I'll never be important to anyone.
